product_metadata.title: Golden State Art, 5x7 Three Picture Frame Trifold Hinged Photo Frame with 3 Openings, Desk Top Family Picture Collage, with Real Glass (5x7 Triple, Beige, 1-Pack)

Folding design for desktop display, simple to load, removable back panels.
